text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If we don't hurry, lunch break is gonna 
end! Where the heck is that girl!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, forgetting to hand the bento to the 
dorm students... How could I be so 
careless...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She must be starving by now... And she was 
looking forward to my bento, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, I can't just stand around 
here! I've gotta deliver this right 
away...!!"

After searching all over the academy to 
deliver lunches to the dorm students, 
Hishi Amazon was completely exhausted.
